context: A married couple recalls an unusual incident at home
purpose: Teach: 次元/語ら/有る/迅速/ものすごい/左手/一家/よほど

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、覚えてる？あの夜、台所でものすごい音がしたでしょう。
lines.en: Hey, do you remember? That night there was a tremendous noise in the kitchen.
lines.style: Wife reminiscing softly, prompting husband to recall together.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、忘れられないよ。一家全員が飛び起きて、しかも私は左手にバットまで握ってた。
lines.en: Ah, unforgettable. The whole family jumped up, and I was even gripping a bat in my left hand.
lines.style: Husband chuckling, recalling the moment with mild embarrassment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あの時のあなた、ものすごい勢いで階段を降りていったよね。迅速な対応って言うのかしら。
lines.en: You went down the stairs with incredible momentum that time. I guess you'd call it a swift response.
lines.style: Wife teasing affectionately, half-mocking his sudden burst of speed.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 正体不明の音が聞こえるとさ、人間って自然に体が動くものが有るんだよ。
lines.en: When you hear an unidentified noise, there's something in humans that naturally makes the body move.
lines.style: Husband explaining sheepishly, trying to justify his rare bit of bravery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: でも結局、棚から落ちた鍋だったなんてね。よほど焦ってたのか、二人とも顔が真っ青で。
lines.en: But in the end, it was just a pot that fell off the shelf. We must have been quite panicked — both our faces were pale.
lines.style: Wife laughing fondly while remembering how alarmed they both looked.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いやあ、あの瞬間の恐怖は次元が違ったって。本気で泥棒だと思ったんだから。
lines.en: No really, the fear in that moment was on a different level. I genuinely thought it was a burglar.
lines.style: Husband insisting earnestly, defending the realness of his fright back then.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今でも友達と語らうたびに思い出すの。うちの一番面白い夜だったって。
lines.en: Even now whenever we share stories with friends I remember it. It was our funniest night ever.
lines.style: Wife smiling warmly, treasuring the shared memory between the two of them.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 面白いって言うなよ。まあ、家族の伝説ってのはそうやって生まれるんだろうな。
lines.en: Don't call it funny. Well, I guess that's how family legends are born after all.
lines.style: Husband mock-protesting, then conceding with quiet warmth and a smile.
